scope: GPU diagnostic only; no timing; no production file edits

settings.anchors: one unhooked forward_fn replay per captured group, same tensor and compiled object

notes: The same runtime and compiled decoder object serve natural B4 and B8 specializations.
Observers wrap existing opaque custom-op implementations; the only module hook is read-only at the eager post_quant_conv boundary.
No module hooks are placed inside the compiled decoder; no eager decoder substitution, norm binding, kernel tuning, or timing is used.
The first temporal tile collection is used; first eight spatial tile indices are matched individually.
Raw captured tensors and tile outputs remain under the task-specific /tmp directory.

redaction.policy: Absolute paths, filename-bearing identifiers, and media-name fields are recursively replaced in dictionary keys and string values with deterministic aliases. Identical original identifiers share an alias; all original dictionary/list entries are retained.
redaction.cached_screen_per_frame_errors: All 124 entries retained; no old-screen rows were dropped.
redaction.payload_policy: No raw tensor payload or third-party source code is included; tensor references are artifact aliases, and source entries retain only SHA-256 values.
